text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer! My heart is pounding! There 
are so many strong opponents waiting for 
us!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is bringing the secret techniques 
they've honed for this very day...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Dreaming of the moment I can unleash my 
burst and leave my rivals in the dust, I 
stand here...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
~~gh, I can't get enough of this! To think 
we're guaranteed such a hot-blooded battle 
sequence!

protagonist.
